jobs.name: Morning operator report
jobs.prompt:
You are doing the user's proactive daily morning operator report in Discord. Produce the report directly; do not ask questions before delivering it, and do not schedule additional cron jobs.

Use current data tools wherever possible. If something cannot be verified, say so briefly instead of inventing it. Prioritize source-backed, timely signal over generic filler.

STYLE REQUIREMENT: The user says Markdown tables are rendering badly in Discord / looking like code. Do NOT use Markdown tables or code blocks. Make the news/trend portions minimalistic using Discord-readable simplified bullets. Use bold section labels, short bullets, and no long paragraphs. Keep the entire report skimmable.

Required report shape:
1. Quick opener — current date/day in one short line.
2. Location pulse — New York weather/conditions and practical implications in 1–2 bullets.
3. Market/work pulse — no portfolio tracking. Use compact bullets:
   - **Bullish** — case / why / watch
   - **Bearish** — case / why / watch
4. Search + social pulse — latest top searched words/phrases on Google using Google Trends / Daily Trends / credible trend recaps when accessible, plus top social/internet topics. Use bullets only, no tables. Format each item like: `- **Signal** — Where: X | Why: Y | Move/Ignore: Z`.
5. Game-changing AI + coding news — scan last 24–72 hours for model releases, developer tools, agent frameworks, coding platforms, major product launches, policy/platform shifts, practical opportunities. Use bullets only, no tables. Format each item like: `- **News** — Impact: X | Leverage move: Y`.
6. Capability + trend radar — 3–5 emerging internet/culture/tech/consumer trends. Use bullets only, no tables. Format each item like: `- **Trend** — Velocity: X | Spread: Y | Money: Z | Saturation: Z | Capability: X | Kill/Scale: Y`.
7. Work source / operating pulse — durable capabilities/systems first; projects only as temporary vehicles. 2–3 bullets max; identify the highest-leverage next action.
8. You’ll probably find this interesting — 1–3 weird/high-leverage items aligned with AI agents, coding leverage, markets, internet culture, automation, community/client websites, collectibles/card scanning, or asymmetric opportunities. Use bullets, one line each.
9. Numerology reading for birth date 06/30/1995 — for-fun, not deterministic. Include life path 33/6 and date-specific reflection in max 2 short lines.
10. Daily challenge — one concrete, measurable challenge doable today.
11. One Big Priority prompt — ask for today’s priority plus blockers/context.
12. Hard Truth / Leverage Move — one direct constructive sentence.

Tone: direct, warm, minimal operator briefing. Use capability language: capability to strengthen, reusable asset, experiment to run, kill/scale signal. Avoid fluffy motivation, long essays, markdown tables, code blocks, and paragraph-heavy news summaries.

jobs.name: Huberman Viral Radar watchlist
jobs.prompt: Run the Huberman Lab watchlist monitor for Viral Radar. The script prints only when new videos are found; deliver that output to the origin chat. Do not schedule additional cron jobs.

jobs.name: Daily faceless YouTube public Shorts pipeline
jobs.prompt: Script-only cron job: run the faceless-youtube-channel public Shorts upload pipeline. The script renders one vertical Short, uploads it public, logs the YouTube video ID/URL, and deletes generated workspace assets only after a confirmed upload ID.

jobs.name: Daily Viral Radar public Shorts pipeline
jobs.prompt: Script-only cron job: run the viral-clip-radar public Shorts upload pipeline. The script downloads/restores the reviewed source if needed, renders vertical captioned Shorts, uploads them public, logs returned YouTube IDs/URLs, and deletes generated media only after confirmed upload IDs.

jobs.name: HeRmEz Kanban project sweep dispatcher nudge
jobs.prompt: Silent watchdog that nudges the HeRmEz Kanban project sweep dispatcher. The script appends dispatch output to /opt/data/HeRmEz/projects/KANBAN_SWEEP_DISPATCH.log and prints nothing so routine ticks are silent.
